recognize_zh: 低倍可見緻密膠原構成的植入物包膜（capsule），其管腔側覆有一層纖維素性滲出物；放大後滲出物中散布大量異型細胞，高倍下為成群大型多形性細胞，核大不規則、染色質粗、可見分裂像；腫瘤細胞局限於包膜腔面的纖維素中，是乳房植入物相關 ALCL 的典型分布。
features: Low power: dense hyalinized fibrous implant capsule with a luminal layer of fibrinous exudate (labeled 'capsule')
Intermediate power: fibrin layer containing numerous scattered atypical cells along the luminal surface, sparing the capsule
High power: clusters of large pleomorphic cells with irregular, reniform or lobulated nuclei and coarse chromatin
Moderate amphophilic to clear cytoplasm; mitotic figures present
Tumor cells embedded in eosinophilic fibrinous and edematous stroma without invasion into the capsule in this field
describe_en: Sections of the breast implant capsule show dense hyalinized fibrous tissue with a luminal layer of fibrinous exudate. At intermediate power, the fibrin layer contains numerous scattered atypical cells, which at high power are clusters of large pleomorphic cells with irregular to reniform nuclei, coarse chromatin, moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and mitotic figures, embedded in fibrinous material. The atypical cells are confined to the luminal fibrin without apparent capsular invasion in these fields. Findings are consistent with breast implant-associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pending confirmation by CD30 and ALK immunostains; the capsule should be fully sampled to assess for invasion or a mass-forming component.

ddx.dx: Reactive capsulitis with fibrin and histiocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive capsules show histiocytes, lymphocytes and occasional activated cells lacking the cohesive clusters of CD30-uniform large atypical cells with T-antigen loss.
This entity also resides in fibrin around implants or devices but consists of CD20+/PAX5+ EBV-positive large B cells rather than CD30+ ALK-negative T cells.
Carcinoma shows cohesive cytokeratin-positive and GATA3-positive nests that are negative for CD30 and T-cell markers.
